field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable the GoWithTheFlow daemon. Installing the plugin does nothing until this is turned on.

field.label: Capture interfaces
field.help: LAN-side interface(s) to passively capture DNS/TLS traffic on.

field.label: Local subnets
field.help: CIDR ranges that count as "local" for connection tracking. Auto-derived from your selected capture interfaces' own subnets if left empty; add VPN tunnel subnets here too if you want VPN clients tracked as local hosts.

field.label: Raw retention (days)
field.help: How long individual closed-connection records are kept before being pruned (once reflected in the hourly rollup).

field.label: CPU limit (%)
field.help: rctl CPU cap applied to the daemon process, so a runaway process gets throttled rather than degrading the box.

field.label: Enable PTR (reverse DNS) fallback
field.help: Only consulted when DNS/SNI have nothing. Disable if you don't want extra reverse-DNS traffic leaving the box.

field.label: Extra TLS ports
field.help: Comma-separated list of additional TCP ports to watch for TLS ClientHello beyond 443 (e.g. 8443).
